reviews.title: $831.48 per year!! wtf!
reviews.text: I downloaded this app to show my friend a couple of hairstyles he should try because he’s in his 60s and trying to date and he has a 40-year-old hairstyle. I think I used it once or twice and thought it was $15.99 once for the year. But no, I looked at my Apple subscription the other day and they charged $15.99 per week since June. I’ve been charged over $200 for an app that I used once or twice. No app should be $830 a year. I don’t even know how that’s legal.  Besides the fact that the name on your Apple subscription is completely different than the name of the app so you have to try and figure out what it is. I would boycott this company  if I were you, I fully intend to.  I just looked and apparently they have an annual subscription for $39.99 yet they charge $831.48 if you make the mistake like I did and got a weekly charge of $15.99. I intend to put this on blast on every forum I can find. Because they are preying on people and I bet most of the time it people under 18 downloading this app. If you wanna refund, it says ask Apple and of course Apple denies everything.

Why has the app turned completely anew and opposite of everything I used to love it for? Why is everything inaccurately produced by AI generation? Why would you renew what once was a completely perfect app I used to gatekeep because you could never top it. BRING IT BACK.

reviews.title: RUINED. The old version was perfect, now it‘s a cash grab.
reviews.text:
This used to be my favorite app. The old FaceLab was perfect — free, simple, and had all the makeup filters I needed. I could just take a screenshot and be done.

But then you updated it, switched to “AI generation”, and completely destroyed everything.

Now there are NO normal filters left. Only horrible, ugly AI-generated makeup that looks nothing like real makeup. And even that is locked behind paid coins. You have to buy coins for every single thing. Nothing is free anymore.

I literally cannot use this app now. It’s completely different. You took away everything that worked and gave us a broken, cash-grab generator instead. Why would anyone like this?

And to make it worse — I‘ve seen many reports of unauthorized charges even after uninstalling the app.

Do better. Bring back the OLD FaceLab. No one asked for this AI garbage.

reviews.title: Rip Off App
reviews.text: Foolishly, I responded to an advertisement on Instagram, thinking this app would be a useful tool.  My error, this app is nothing but a cash grab.  The 3-day “free trial” does not include actual use of the advertised feature, that requires an additional 1-time payment.  Trying to use the FAQs was just like watching another advertisement.  I’ll hand it to the creators, they do an excellent job of selling and marketing a false promise.  Save yourself time and money, just move on, there’s nothing worthwhile here.
